gripOrHq.title: Subliminal Corruption
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run. Give the Corp 1 Bad Publicity point for each advertisement you trash during the run. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

gripOrHq.title: Scaldan
gripOrHq.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Scaldan counter. Each Scaldan counter forces the Corp to roll a die at the start of each of its turns. On a 5 or a 6, the Corp gains 1 Bad Publicity point. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

gripOrHq.title: Frame-Up
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on both HQ and R&D this turn. Give the Corp 1 Bad Publicity point. Give the Corp 1 additional Bad Publicity point if you liberated or trashed any Black Ops cards during those runs. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

gripOrHq.title: Live News Feed
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run. If run is successful, the Corp gives you two tags, and you give the Corp 1 Bad Publicity point for each black ice you encountered during the run, 1 for each Black Ops card the Corp rezzed during the run, and 1 for each Black Ops agenda you liberated during the run. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

gripOrHq.title: Senatorial Field Trip
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if the Corp rezzed a piece of Black Ice this turn. The Corp either derezzes that piece of ice or receives 2 Bad Publicity points. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

heapOrArchives.title: Taxman
heapOrArchives.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Tax counter. Every two Tax counters cause the Corp to lose [1] at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Blackmail
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, score 1 agenda point.

heapOrArchives.title: Crumble
heapOrArchives.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Crumble counter. Two or more Crumble counters allow you trash, at no cost, any cards accessed from HQ, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Viral Pipeline
heapOrArchives.rulesText: After each successful run on Archives, HQ, or R&D, put a Socket counter in that data fort. Socket counter from Archives, Socket counter from HQ, and Socket counter from R&D: Give the Corp a Pipe counter. Each Pipe counter causes the Corp to forgo an action at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Highlighter
heapOrArchives.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Highlighter counter. Each Highlighter counter after the first allows you to access an additional card from R&D whenever you access cards from R&D. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Credit Subversion
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [T]: The Corp loses [3]. Use this ability immediately after a successful run on HQ. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

heapOrArchives.title: Death from Above
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [T]: Trash, at no cost, all cards installed in a subsidiary data fort, even if they cannot normally be trashed. Use this ability only when you have just successfully made a run on that fort, and before accessing cards from that fort. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

heapOrArchives.title: Crumble
heapOrArchives.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Crumble counter. Two or more Crumble counters allow you trash, at no cost, any cards accessed from HQ, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Demolition Run
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. If run is successful, do not access cards; instead, trash all rezzed ice on the fort on which you just made a run, and the Corp gives you three tags.

heapOrArchives.title: R&D Mole
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [4], [T]: Access two additional cards from R&D. Use this ability only when accessing cards from R&D. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

heapOrArchives.title: Demolition Run
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. If run is successful, do not access cards; instead, trash all rezzed ice on the fort on which you just made a run, and the Corp gives you three tags.

heapOrArchives.title: Disgruntled Ice Technician
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. After passing a piece of ice during this run, you may derez that ice and end your run if you broke all the subroutines of that ice.

heapOrArchives.title: Viral Pipeline
heapOrArchives.rulesText: After each successful run on Archives, HQ, or R&D, put a Socket counter in that data fort. Socket counter from Archives, Socket counter from HQ, and Socket counter from R&D: Give the Corp a Pipe counter. Each Pipe counter causes the Corp to forgo an action at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Back Door to Rivals
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [0]: Base link 2. [3]: +1 link. Gain [1] whenever you successfully use Back Door to Rivals to avoid a trace. Use only one base link card for each trace attempt made against you.

heapOrArchives.title: Faked Hit
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Give the Corp 1 Bad Publicity point. Take 2 brain damage. This damage cannot be prevented. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

heapOrArchives.title: Decoy Signal
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. Whenever you approach an unrezzed piece of ice during that run, expose it. You may jack out before the Corp decides whether to rez the ice.

scoreArea.title: Hostile Takeover
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [5] when you score Hostile Takeover.

rig.title: Garbage In
rig.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Garbage counter. Two or more Garbage counters allow you to trash, at no cost, any cards accessed from R&D, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed. The Corp loses two Garbage counters after any run during which this ability is used. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

rig.title: Chiba Bank Account
rig.rulesText: [1], [T]: Gain [4]. You may use this ability whenever you pay any cost or penalty. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

rig.title: HQ Mole
rig.rulesText: [4], [T]: Access two additional cards from HQ. Use this ability only when accessing cards from HQ. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

rig.title: Streetware Distributor
rig.rulesText: Take [1] from Streetware Distributor, if it has any bits, at the start of each of your turns. A: Put [3] from the bank on Streetware Distributor.

rig.title: Back Door to Netwatch
rig.rulesText: [3], [T]: Cancel the effect of a successful trace. Give the Corp 1 Bad Publicity point if the trace would have had an effect other than or in addition to giving you any tags. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

scoreArea.title: Corporate Downsizing
scoreArea.rulesText: When you score Corporate Downsizing, show to Runner any number of agenda cards stored in HQ. Gain bits equal to twice the combined agenda points of these cards; then shuffle them into R&D.

scoreArea.title: On-Call Solo Team
scoreArea.rulesText: A: Do 1 meat damage. Use this ability only if Runner is tagged.

scoreArea.title: Hostile Takeover
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [5] when you score Hostile Takeover.

ice.title: Shock.r
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during the run, and cannot jack out until after that encounter.

ice.title: Ball and Chain
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, Runner must pay [2] when encountering a piece of ice, in addition to any other costs, or end the run.

ice.title: Ball and Chain
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, Runner must pay [2] when encountering a piece of ice, in addition to any other costs, or end the run.

root.title: Chester Mix
root.rulesText: The cost to install ice on this fort is reduced by [2].

root.title: City Surveillance
root.rulesText: For each card Runner draws, give Runner a tag unless Runner pays [1], in addition to any other costs, to avoid receiving that tag. You may rez City Surveillance just before the card is drawn.

root.title: Planning Consultants
root.rulesText: Look at the top five cards of R&D and arrange them in any order you choose.

root.title: Off-Site Backups
root.rulesText: Bring any card from the Archives into HQ.

root.title: Project Consultants
root.rulesText: Add four advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

root.title: Project Consultants
root.rulesText: Add four advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

ice.title: Fetch 4.0.1
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 3 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.
